outcome: Filter the complete server-owned personal watchlist by Shanghai, Shenzhen, Beijing or existing unconnected observation references, combined with code/name search, before counting and paging. Reset restores all markets and page one.

verification.tdd: Before implementation the selector suite failed on its missing module and the view regression failed on the missing market label. The version test failed against 1.0.7 before the update.
verification.staticChecks: Web typecheck, related ESLint, Prettier and diff checks passed; no local aggregate repository suite was run.
verification.build: One shared Docker Node build of web and server passed, including TypeScript and Vite. Later documentation leaves application source, dependencies and runtime configuration unchanged; the verified build is reused.

browser.environment: Authenticated actual local application and existing storage; no fixture API, credential change, import or notification action.
passed: The actual list contained 195 saved entries: market filters counted 73 Shanghai, 117 Shenzhen, 1 Beijing and 4 unconnected observation references; rendered rows matched their selected category.
Switching market from page 2 reset to page 1. A trimmed lowercase code combined with Shanghai matched one existing entry; choosing Shenzhen with that code showed an explicit zero-match state.
Keyboard Enter activated reset, restoring all markets, an empty search and page 1 of 10 with 195 entries.
Select and actionable button cursors computed to pointer; disabled controls computed to not-allowed. Tab reached reset with visible focus; the search used a text cursor.
Both labels measured an 8px gap. At a 390px override the client and scroll width were both 375px, with a 309px watchlist region and usable wrapped controls. The override was reset.
The selected public sample retained its real Oct 22 daily quote, original source and collection status.
browser.screenshot: Actual accepted page retained in ignored local work; only one public symbol, curated samples and the generic local administrator label are visible.

verification.review: Primary-agent final diff review completed without a blocker. Scope is a medium-risk read-only presentation slice; server storage, ownership checks, contracts, collection and notification actions are unchanged.

localRuntime.containers: Web and server healthy; only application containers were recreated, preserving existing databases and workers.

knownLimits: Market grouping is based on the existing validated canonical code or observation-reference format; it does not classify collection health, missing data or master-data lifecycle readiness.
The filter applies only to the currently loaded server-owned list and preserves its order. Quotes are still queried only for the current page; no full-list quote sorting is added.
This accepts a P6-N07 UI slice, not the complete node or Phase 6. No production deployment or trading capability is claimed.
